"""Bounded, fail-closed declarative READ_ONLY_SQL schema metadata capability tests."""
from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from modules.integrations_runtime.read_only_sql import validate_readonly_sql
from modules.worker_ingress import service
from modules.worker_ingress.semantic_capabilities import (
    capability_catalog,
    registered_capabilities,
    sql_schema_metadata_profiles,
)
from tools.mirror_sync import readonly_audit_profiles as profiles
from tools.mirror_sync.gate_chain_publisher import validate_template
from tools.mirror_sync.universal_job_result_publisher import sanitize_readonly_evidence

USER = {
    "id": "1",
    "email": "test-admin@example.invalid",
    "role": "SuperAdministrador",
    "permissions": ["worker:submit", "worker:status"],
}

EXPECTED_CAJAS_OBJECTS = (
    "Finanzas_CortesCaja",
    "Finanzas_CuadresZ",
    "Usuario_Autorizaciones",
    "Sistema_Tareas",
    "Operativo_Notificaciones_Queue",
)


def req(**changes):
    payload = {
        "objective": "Auditar metadatos SQL autorizados de Cajas en modo READ_ONLY_SQL.",
        "bounded_context": "COMERCIAL_POS",
        "capability": "SQL_SCHEMA_METADATA_AUDIT_READONLY",
        "mode": "READ_ONLY_SQL",
        "request_key": "TEST-CAJAS-SQL-METADATA-R1",
        "constraints": {"profile": "cajas_incidencias_schema_metadata_v1"},
    }
    payload.update(changes)
    return payload


def test_cajas_sql_metadata_profile_allowlisted_and_envelope_valid():
    assert profiles.is_allowed_readonly_audit_profile(
        profiles.CAJAS_INCIDENCIAS_SCHEMA_METADATA_V1
    )
    job = service.build_semantic_job(req(), current_user=USER)
    assert validate_template(job)["schema"] == "edarsahub.worker-job.v2"
    assert job["mode"] == "READ_ONLY_SQL"
    assert job["actions"] == []
    assert job["production_allowed"] is False
    assert len(job["checks"]) == 1
    check = job["checks"][0]
    assert check["type"] == "sql_readonly_audit"
    assert check["source"] == "EDARSAHUB"
    assert len(check["queries"]) == 5

    # Default single domain profile also works when constraints is empty {}
    job_default = service.build_semantic_job(req(constraints={}), current_user=USER)
    assert job_default["checks"] == job["checks"]


def test_cajas_sql_metadata_queries_are_sealed_select_only_and_bounded_to_5_objects():
    job = service.build_semantic_job(req(), current_user=USER)
    queries = job["checks"][0]["queries"]
    names = [q["name"] for q in queries]
    assert names == [
        "cajas_sql_identity",
        "cajas_target_tables",
        "cajas_target_columns",
        "cajas_target_primary_unique_keys",
        "cajas_target_foreign_keys",
    ]
    for query in queries:
        sql = query["sql"]
        assert sql.lstrip().upper().startswith("SELECT ")
        assert validate_readonly_sql(sql) == sql
        upper = f" {sql.upper()} "
        for forbidden in (
            " INSERT ", " UPDATE ", " DELETE ", " MERGE ",
            " DROP ", " ALTER ", " CREATE ", " EXEC ",
            " GRANT ", " DENY ", " REVOKE ", " TRUNCATE ",
        ):
            assert forbidden not in upper
        if query["name"] != "cajas_sql_identity":
            for obj in EXPECTED_CAJAS_OBJECTS:
                assert f"'{obj}'" in sql
            assert "TABLE_SCHEMA='dbo'" in sql or "s.name='dbo'" in sql


@pytest.mark.parametrize("changes", [
    {"mode": "MUTATION"},
    {"mode": "READ_ONLY"},
])
def test_cajas_sql_metadata_rejects_non_readonly_sql_modes(changes):
    with pytest.raises(service.WorkerIngressError, match="SEMANTIC_CAPABILITY_MODE_MISMATCH"):
        service.build_semantic_job(req(**changes), current_user=USER)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("changes", [
    {"bounded_context": "OTHER_DOMAIN"},
    {"constraints": {"sql": "SELECT 1"}},
    {"constraints": {"queries": [{"name": "a", "sql": "SELECT 1"}]}},
    {"constraints": {"tables": ["Usuario_Catalogo"]}},
    {"constraints": {"objects": ["Servidores_Conexiones"]}},
    {"constraints": {"source": "SERVER"}},
    {"constraints": {"source": "POS"}},
    {"constraints": {"connection": "live"}},
    {"constraints": {"server_id": "d8b2d1eb-2e1f-4e43-b7d9-822bf671e315"}},
    {"constraints": {"profile": "unknown_profile_v1"}},
    {"constraints": {"profile": "chapur_connection_discovery_v1"}},
    {"constraints": {"actions": []}},
    {"constraints": {"checks": []}},
])
def test_cajas_sql_metadata_rejects_arbitrary_sql_connections_and_objects(changes):
    with pytest.raises(service.WorkerIngressError, match="SEMANTIC_"):
        service.build_semantic_job(req(**changes), current_user=USER)


def test_cajas_sql_metadata_evidence_sanitizes_cleanly():
    raw_result = {
        "checks": [
            {
                "type": "sql_readonly_audit",
                "sql_evidence": {
                    "status": "PASS",
                    "mode": "READ_ONLY_SQL",
                    "connection": "readonly_sql_connection:default",
                    "evidence": [
                        {
                            "name": "cajas_sql_identity",
                            "columns": ["db_name", "login_name", "db_user"],
                            "rows": [["EDARSAHUB", "HRLectura", "HRLectura"]],
                            "row_count_returned": 1,
                            "truncated": False,
                        },
                        {
                            "name": "cajas_target_tables",
                            "columns": ["TABLE_SCHEMA", "TABLE_NAME", "TABLE_TYPE"],
                            "rows": [["dbo", obj, "BASE TABLE"] for obj in EXPECTED_CAJAS_OBJECTS],
                            "row_count_returned": len(EXPECTED_CAJAS_OBJECTS),
                            "truncated": False,
                        },
                    ],
                },
            }
        ]
    }
    sanitized = sanitize_readonly_evidence(raw_result)
    assert sanitized is not None
    assert len(sanitized["checks"]) == 1
    assert sanitized["checks"][0]["connection"] == "readonly_sql_connection:default"
    assert sanitized["checks"][0]["evidence"][0]["rows"] == [["EDARSAHUB", "HRLectura", "HRLectura"]]


def test_existing_readonly_profiles_and_catalog_parity_preserved():
    for existing in (
        profiles.CHAPUR_CONNECTION_DISCOVERY_V1,
        profiles.API_FACTORY_PERSISTENCE_STATE_V1,
        profiles.SQL_RUNTIME_PRINCIPAL_PERMISSIONS_V1,
        profiles.WORKER_OPERATIONS_SQL_STATE_V1,
        profiles.WORKER_CONSOLE_ENTERPRISE_MENU_V1,
    ):
        assert profiles.is_allowed_readonly_audit_profile(existing)
        assert len(profiles.build_readonly_audit_checks(existing)) == 1

    assert "SQL_SCHEMA_METADATA_AUDIT_READONLY" in registered_capabilities()
    reg_profiles = sql_schema_metadata_profiles()
    assert profiles.CAJAS_INCIDENCIAS_SCHEMA_METADATA_V1 in reg_profiles
    assert reg_profiles[profiles.CAJAS_INCIDENCIAS_SCHEMA_METADATA_V1].allowed_objects == EXPECTED_CAJAS_OBJECTS

    catalog = {item["code"]: item for item in capability_catalog()}
    entry = catalog["SQL_SCHEMA_METADATA_AUDIT_READONLY"]
    assert entry["modes"] == ["READ_ONLY_SQL"]
    assert "COMERCIAL_POS" in entry["bounded_context_rule"].split("|")
    assert entry["allowed_constraints"] == ["profile"]
    assert entry["limits"]["fixed_source"] == "EDARSAHUB"
    assert entry["limits"]["arbitrary_sql_allowed"] is False


def test_cajas_sql_metadata_submits_only_via_canonical_publisher(monkeypatch):
    submitted = []

    def fake_submit(job, **_kwargs):
        submitted.append(job)
        return {"status": "SUBMITTED", "job_id": job["job_id"], "production_touched": False}

    monkeypatch.setattr(service.gate_chain_publisher, "submit", fake_submit)
    res = service.submit_objective(req(), current_user=USER)
    assert res["status"] == "SUBMITTED"
    assert len(submitted) == 1
    assert submitted[0]["mode"] == "READ_ONLY_SQL"
    assert submitted[0]["actions"] == []
    assert submitted[0]["production_allowed"] is False


def test_cajas_sql_metadata_also_registered_in_sql_readonly_profile_audit():
    job = service.build_semantic_job(
        {
            "objective": "Auditar metadatos SQL de Cajas via SQL_READONLY_PROFILE_AUDIT.",
            "bounded_context": "COMERCIAL_POS",
            "capability": "SQL_READONLY_PROFILE_AUDIT",
            "mode": "READ_ONLY_SQL",
            "request_key": "TEST-CAJAS-PROFILE-AUDIT-R2",
            "constraints": {"profile_code": "CAJAS_INCIDENCIAS_SCHEMA_METADATA_V1"},
        },
        current_user=USER,
    )
    assert validate_template(job)["schema"] == "edarsahub.worker-job.v2"
    assert job["mode"] == "READ_ONLY_SQL"
    assert job["production_allowed"] is False
    assert len(job["checks"][0]["queries"]) == 5
